opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals and organisations, especially from racially minoritised communities; partnership applications encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, focusing on inter‑generational changes, continuities and challenges, and how these relate to the UK’s colonial past and evolving societal context.

opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: offers up to £500,000 for research; special cases up to £750,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be based in the UK; individuals need formal employment or contractual relationship with a UK host institution; projects led by organisations not based in the UK are not funded except in exceptional cases.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £500,000 for research addressing one or more of the Foundation’s five priority questions, with most grants below £300,000; two application deadlines per year (Spring and Autumn).
